steps.en: An endorsement work item is routed to the officer's dashboard
steps.id: Work item endorsement di-route ke dashboard officer
steps.why_en: No dashboard exists and the work item is assigned to the creator.
steps.why_id: Dashboard tidak ada dan work item di-assign ke pembuatnya.

steps.en: Officer views the decision made on the notice
steps.id: Officer melihat keputusan yang dibuat atas notice
steps.why_en: The endorsement screen exists but is hidden outside staging.
steps.why_id: Layar endorsement ada tetapi tersembunyi di luar staging.

steps.en: Officer endorses or rejects the decision
steps.why_en: The form exists, but nothing behind it handles the endorsement command.
steps.why_id: Form ada, tetapi tidak ada kode di belakangnya yang menangani perintah endorsement.

steps.why_en: Recording is sent only on staging and has nothing receiving it.
steps.why_id: Pencatatan hanya dikirim di staging dan tidak ada yang menerimanya.

steps.en: A rejected decision is re-routed to the sending OIC
steps.id: Keputusan yang ditolak di-route ulang ke OIC pengirim
steps.why_en: Rejection does nothing; there is no re-routing.
steps.why_id: Penolakan tidak melakukan apa-apa; tidak ada routing ulang.

steps.en: An alert reaches the routing OIC's dashboard
steps.id: Alert masuk ke dashboard OIC yang me-route
steps.why_en: No dashboard and no alert mechanism exist.
steps.why_id: Dashboard dan mekanisme alert tidak ada.
